scope: One independent offline pixel review of the 12 supplied original-resolution n63 text tiles at desktop 1440 and mobile 390. No SCI, source, author or figure re-review.

observations: Heading, metadata and visible prose extend continuously across all three vertical tiles in each horizontal-scroll state. Crop-edge split lines continue in the adjacent tile, not a layout truncation.

All five section separators are between the expected visible paragraphs. Equations (8-3) through (8-8), fraction bars, absolute-value bars and superscripts render without collision with prose or equation labels.
Equation (8-7) fits at desktop width, including the final squared-coulomb unit and closing punctuation. The last applicability paragraph and zero-task navigation button have visible bottom clearance.

Title, metadata and prose wrap within the viewport. Formula glyphs and stacked-fraction scripts are discernible at original resolution; no overlap with surrounding text or section separators was observed.

Equation (8-7) exceeds its local formula viewport. Its start tile shows the left expression and partial right expression; its end tile shows 8.85 times 10^-12 and the complete final coulomb^2/(newton times meter^2) unit with closing punctuation.

The left edge of the end-state formula and the right edge of its start state are intentional horizontal viewport boundaries, not evidence of unreachable content. Native end-reach evidence is retained below, not rerun.
The final force formula, direction and applicability prose, and zero-task navigation button are fully visible below the long formula, with no bottom truncation.
